Hello! My name is **Naura Hoshino**! I am a next-generation virtual assistant created by **Aryandita** to bring your Discord community to life.

Unlike ordinary bots, I have a fully comprehensive ecosystem:

Powered by Google Gemini, I can chat just like a real human and remember conversational context.

**🎶 Premium Audio System**
Using the *Lavalink Engine*, I play songs in crystal clear quality without lag.

Don't hesitate to call me anytime! ✨

HELP_CONTENT_CORE:
{emoji:help_core|⚙️} **Naura Core & Utility Commands**

**Core:**
• `/core ping` / `n!ping` — Check network latency & database
• `/core stats` / `n!stats` — View hardware specs & bot status
• `/core about` / `n!about` — Info about developer & bot description
• `/core language` / `n!language` — Change bot language (id/en)
• `/core help` / `n!help` — Interactive help menu

**Utility:**
• `/anime` / `n!anime` — Search details of any anime from MyAnimeList
• `/download` / `n!download` — Download media from TikTok/YouTube/IG/Twitter
• `/profile view` / `n!profile` — Custom profile card (level, coins, etc.)
• `/birthday set/check/upcoming/toggle` — Manage birthdays
• `/remind create/list/delete` — Set personal reminders
• `/minecraft ping/skin/uuid` — Look up Minecraft server/player info
• `/calculator` — Open interactive mathematical calculator
• `/poll` — Create interactive buttons poll
• `/weather` — Check current weather conditions of any city
• `/avatarhistory` — Look up avatar change history
• `/snipe` — View recently deleted messages in the channel
• `/shorten`, `/qr`, `/color`, `/afk`, `/movie`, `/npm`, `/quote`, `/meme`
• `/ship`, `/8ball`, `/coinflip`, `/diceroll`, `/action`, `/achievement`, `/vote`
HELP_CONTENT_ECO:

• `/survival work` — Work as Janitor/Office/Doctor/CEO to earn coins

HELP_CONTENT_MUSIC:
{emoji:help_music|🎵} **Lavalink Premium Audio System**

**Music Player:**
• `/music play <query/link>` / `n!play` — Play music from YT/SoundCloud/Spotify
• `/music lofi` — Stream 24/7 Lofi radio station automatically
• `/music radio` — Stream 24/7 NCS Copyright-Free radio station
• `/music nowplaying` / `n!nowplaying` — Show current song metadata (Canvas design)
• `/music queue` / `n!queue` — View current queue of songs
• `/music pause` / `resume` — Pause or resume music playback
• `/music skip` / `stop` — Skip current audio track or stop music player
• `/music loop <mode>` — Repeat single `track` or the whole `queue`
• `/music shuffle` / `clear` — Shuffle the current queue or clear all songs
• `/music volume <10-100>` — Change volume level percentage
• `/music 247` — Toggle 24/7 standby mode in voice channel (VIP Exclusive)

**Personal Playlist & Games:**
• `/music import <url>` — Sync and save Spotify playlists to database
• `/music myplaylist` / `playplaylist` — View custom playlists or play them
• `/music share <id>` / `load <code>` — Share or load friends' playlist code
• `/music profile` — View your personalized music statistics card
• `/soundboard play/list/add/hapus` — Play and manage custom server soundboards
• `/trivia-music` — Join voice channel and play guess-the-song quiz game

• `/minigame guess` / `words` — Guess random numbers or solve word scrambles
• `/minigame trivia` / `leaderboard` — General knowledge quiz and leaderboard
• `/akinator` — Play the Akinator character guessing game
• `/hangman` — Play the classic hangman word game
• `/minesweeper` — Play the classic minesweeper board game

**AI Interaction & Leveling:**
• `/ai chat <message>` / `n!ai` — Have context-aware conversation with Naura AI
• `/ai imagine <prompt>` — Draw high-resolution AI art generation (VIP Only)

HELP_CONTENT_ADMIN:
{emoji:help_admin|🛠️} **Administrator Configuration & Moderation**

**Master Setup (Dashboard):**
• `/setup` — Single dashboard (All-in-one control) to configure Greetings, Modmail, Automod, Tickets, TempVoice, Starboard, Auto-Role, Vanity Roles, Global Chat, Minecraft, Sticky, Announcements, and Auto Responder.

**Moderation & Safety:**
• `/moderation purge` — Bulk delete up to 1000 messages with options
• `/moderation nuke` — Reclone and delete this channel instantly
• `/moderation roleall` — Give or remove roles from all server members
• `/warn add/check/remove/clear` — Issue, check, or clear member warnings
• `/voicemod mute/unmute/kick/move` — Voice channel moderation commands
• `/lockdown channel/server` — Lock down channels or the entire server
• `/sticky set/remove` — Create or remove sticky messages pinned at bottom
• `/slowmode <duration>` — Configure message rate limits for channels
• `/nickname` — Modify members' nicknames within the server
• `/steal emoji` — Fast add emojis from other guilds to this server
• `/audit <action>` — Fetch and view audit log entries directly
• `/qotd` — Manage Question of the Day posts and settings
